## Task 1035

We've discovered over time that more and more of our customers choose to access our online ordering system via their mobile phones. While we originally focused on offering a desktop-first experience, the masses have spoken and it's time to make a change. As a cutting-edge sandwich company, our customers have come to expect the latest-and-greatest in sandwich ordering technology. That's why it's time to update our experience to support a more mobile-friendly experience, while continuing to support our legacy desktop users as well.

Unfortunately, our design team is too preoccupied with other tasks at the moment, but they have given us latitude as engineers to make reasonable design decisions and assumptions to implement mobile responsiveness.

## Deliverable

- [ ] The layout of the sandwich list is reconfigured for smaller displays to ensure everything remains readable and optomized for the smaller surface
- [ ] The page header is compacted for smaller displays, and the navigation elements are small-screen-happy too
- [ ] The cart page reasonably scales to a mobile display as well
